title: Creature Shock
native_title: クリーチャー・ショック
overview:
A.D. 2123...

With Earth ruined by human activity, the survey ship UNS Amazon heads out with an exploration fleet in search of new worlds to settle. On the way to Saturn it is seized by a vast alien organism disguised as an asteroid. As Commander Jason Barr, you are sent in to find out what happened.

Creature Shock is a 3D shooter in two styles. Pilot your fighter along set flight paths through pre-rendered space and alien landscapes, blasting enemy craft, then continue on foot in first-person, choosing which way to go at each junction and gunning down the grotesque creatures that lie in wait. Full-motion video carries the story across two discs.
